result:
I've answered Review 1 and set status.md back to READY FOR REVIEW at 11:38Z, ahead of the 12:05Z limit. The evidence is synced; the GPU is idle and no test profile is left behind.

**Item 1, the Gemma-4-26B tails: it's the worse case, not just a prefill-burst trade-off.** In 3 of 5 c512 runs of 54385f76, lanes get suspended.
- **Why:** with the cap lifted, nothing limits the first wave of admissions. The seat-to-end gate only starts limiting once one request has finished and its size is known. So all 512 requests get seats, while the 5,887-page pool can only carry 309 to the end (each needs 19 pages).
- **What the debug trace shows in the stalled runs:**
  - the pool drops to 45 and then 6 free pages;
  - 17–18 processes are paused, their cache copied to host memory and back within ~0.5 s (copied, not recomputed, so no tokens are replayed);
  - requests for new pages queue up, so groups of 100–260 lanes stop at the same token for 0.6–2.7 s.
- **Main stalls differently:** its stalls are ~360 ms, the length of one large prefill fire, with 0 pauses in the trace. The gap between a request's first and second token, while the rest of its admission wave is prefilled, appears on both builds and on its own keeps p99 under 100 ms.

**The 4 alternating runs plus 4 traced ones (c512):**

| | ITL p99 (ms) | tok/s | time to first token, median (s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| main (3 runs) | 177–360 | 4,677–4,868 | 6.6–7.1 |
| fix, clean (2 runs) | 89–90 | 5,155–5,162 | 2.3 |
| fix, stalled (3 runs) | 430–680 | 4,793–5,073 | 2.8–3.1 |

- Every request completes in every run.
- The fix's throughput and time to first token beat main's in every run, stalled ones included.
- The worst request latency (p99) is better on the clean runs (14.2 s against main's 16.8–17.8 s) and up to 19.3 s on a stalled one.

**Decision for you:** whether this ships as it is. The likely fix is to limit the first wave until one request's size is known: keep the cap until then, or estimate each request as prompt + max_tokens. That would hold admission to about 309 here. I haven't implemented or measured it. The Gemma-4-31B rise in ITL p99 at c1024 (49 → 481 ms) is probably the same thing, but I haven't traced it.

**Item 2, the GPU tests:** this was finished before your review arrived.
- Library tests: 69/69 pass.
- Integration tests: 58 passed, 1 skipped, 1 failed. The 8 that died while the disk was full all passed when rerun.
- `a_joined_projection_answers_what_its_legs_answer` fails the same way on the base build: same 0.2207 gap, same panics at lines 245 and 309.
- Expert-parallel tests: 5 of 6 pass. The failing one panics at line 358 on both builds.

Item 3: I updated pr.md's numbers but left its wording alone. The full tables, scripts (`tails.py` to `tails4.py`) and traced logs are in report.md §7 and `results/x26b/rv1*`.
